verdict.rationale: An OS could plausibly ship AI insights over a user's data, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack documents no Windows feature that generates insights or suggestions from user data. Copilot is described as working inside separate Microsoft apps (Word, Excel, PowerPoint). Windows AI APIs and the AI Foundry toolkit are developer building blocks. Paint Cocreator and Live Captions are adjacent generative and accessibility features, and 'Local AI: AI tools on Windows' is a bare heading with no description of data insights.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
